input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen (flagship row 2): changepoint-detector, synthetic control on a real few-donor panel

doc_friction.issue: The default output is ~20 rows of very long lines; finding the 'Start here' line cost a scroll. A --brief mode printing only the pick would save context.
changepoint-detector's 'next a real deployer's panel, few donors' did not say whether a published research panel counts; I read it as yes for 'few donors' and left 'a real deployer's panel' open.

deviations.why: The prior round's 'Next' was a range test on a few-donor series; I ran the single-date test first, since the few-donor floor (p >= 1/17) already decides most of what a range test could show.
deviations.did: Pre-registered six bars on two published 17-unit panels with the shipped defaults; range test left for later.
deviations.result: 3 of 6 bars passed; the product notes shipped as pre-decided.

notes: Data: pysyncon's MIT copies of the Synth basque data and the ADH 2015 OECD panel via raw.githubusercontent.com (sha256 in data/SOURCE.md). Pre-registration committed (commit 2 on the branch) before any fit. Results: West Germany gap -1297 USD/yr (paper ~-1600), floored rank 3/17 (paper's ratio rank 1); Basque gap -0.895k, rank 4/17 with fit warning; in-time placebos and leave-one-out hold. Shipped: FEW DONORS note under 19 donors and the list of placebos ranked above the treated unit (CLI, --json 'above', page). Local checks: node --test on the four synth test files 33/33; run_venture_tests.py changepoint-detector 853 tests ok (203 s); venture-preflight clean; check_posts ok; validate.py ok. No agent doc in docs/reports: the README section and flagships next carry everything the next run needs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a statistician sourcing two replication panels, pre-registering, running placebo/LOO checks, adding two CLI/page notes with tests, and writing it up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
